authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5110 jantu documents the creature-to-snake sense in Niya and Dardic žan/zan/ǰan forms, including Pashai and Torwali comparanda. The Kohistani survey zān forms fit that regional snake family; the exact intra-Indo-Aryan route remains open. Exact survey form zān is retained.
